label: data governance and management practices
definition: Training, validation and testing data sets must be subject to appropriate data governance and management practices for the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system.
source_quote: Training, validation and testing data sets shall be subject to data governance and management practices appropriate for the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system.

label: bias detection and correction
definition: An assessment of possible biases affecting health and safety or fundamental rights, and appropriate measures to detect, prevent and mitigate them.
source_quote: examination in view of possible biases that are likely to affect the health and safety of persons, have a negative impact on fundamental rights or lead to discrimination prohibited under Union law

label: bias detection and correction
definition: Appropriate measures to detect, prevent and mitigate possible biases identified according to point (f).
source_quote: appropriate measures to detect, prevent and mitigate possible biases identified according to point (f)

label: data quality criteria
definition: Training, validation and testing data sets must be relevant, sufficiently representative, free of errors, complete, and have appropriate statistical properties.
source_quote: Training, validation and testing data sets shall be relevant, sufficiently representative, and to the best extent possible, free of errors and complete in view of the intended purpose.

label: special categories processing conditions
definition: Conditions that must be met when providers exceptionally process special categories of personal data for bias detection and correction in high-risk AI systems.
source_quote: all the following conditions must be met in order for such processing to occur:

label: bias detection and correction necessity
definition: The bias detection and correction cannot be effectively fulfilled by processing other data, including synthetic or anonymised data.
source_quote: the bias detection and correction cannot be effectively fulfilled by processing other data, including synthetic or anonymised data;

label: technical limitations on re-use
definition: The special categories of personal data are subject to technical limitations on the re-use of the personal data, and state-of-the-art security and privacy-preserving measures.
source_quote: the special categories of personal data are subject to technical limitations on the re-use of the personal data, and state-of-the-art security and privacy-preserving measures, including pseudonymisation;

label: security and access controls
definition: The special categories of personal data are subject to measures to ensure that the personal data processed are secured, protected, subject to suitable safeguards, including strict controls and documentation of the access.
source_quote: the special categories of personal data are subject to measures to ensure that the personal data processed are secured, protected, subject to suitable safeguards, including strict controls and documentation of the access, to avoid misuse and ensure that only authorised persons have access to those personal data with appropriate confidentiality obligations;

label: data transmission restrictions
definition: The special categories of personal data are not to be transmitted, transferred or otherwise accessed by other parties.
source_quote: the special categories of personal data are not to be transmitted, transferred or otherwise accessed by other parties;

label: data deletion requirement
definition: The special categories of personal data are deleted once the bias has been corrected or the personal data has reached the end of its retention period, whichever comes first.
source_quote: the special categories of personal data are deleted once the bias has been corrected or the personal data has reached the end of its retention period, whichever comes first;

label: processing activity records
definition: The records of processing activities include the reasons why the processing of special categories of personal data was strictly necessary to detect and correct biases.
source_quote: the records of processing activities pursuant to Regulations (EU) 2016/679 and (EU) 2018/1725 and Directive (EU) 2016/680 include the reasons why the processing of special categories of personal data was strictly necessary to detect and correct biases, and why that objective could not be achieved by processing other data.
